note: Kela-subsidised routes. Kela pays a share; the person pays an omavastuu. The cost note must state that plainly — 'subsidised' on its own tells nobody what they will pay. PROVISIONAL until clinician sign-off.

entries.note: Requires three months of treatment contact and a psychiatrist's statement. The omavastuu figure in the cost note is a typical range and MUST be confirmed against Kela's current rates before launch. Role is 'care': this is the therapy itself, subsidised — the application process is how you reach it, not what it is. Re-read 2026-11-12: kela.fi/kuntoutuspsykoterapia unchanged: 'jos olet 16–67-vuotias', care for 'vähintään 3 kuukauden ajan', a B-lausunto or rehabilitation plan with a psychiatrist's assessment, the therapist 'täytyy olla Kelan hyväksymä', 'yksilöpsykoterapia 57,60 euroa/käyntikerta' and 'voit joutua maksamaan osan hinnasta itse'. Kela states no language the therapy is given in (its provider search has a per-provider 'Palvelun kieli'), so fi/sv/en is left as it was; open item for Amir. Decided by Amir 12.11.2026 (E18): Kela has no page stating the languages the therapy is given in: kela.fi/kuntoutuspsykoterapia, /rehabilitative-psychotherapy and /rehabiliterande-psykoterapi (read 12.11.2026) say nothing on it, since it depends on the therapist (Kela's provider search lists each one's 'Palvelun kieli'). The card shows 'not stated, so check the site' (languagesRef); languages stays fi/sv/en for ordering only.
